children: Medicus Pharma and Yorkville mutually terminated their Standby Equity Purchase Agreement effective Sep 11, 2026. The SEPA, signed Feb 10, 2025, had allowed the company to sell up to $15.0 million of common shares. There were no outstanding borrowings, advance notices, or shares to be issued at termination, and no fees are due by either party. Yorkville Securities, an affiliate, continues as a sales agent under Medicus Pharma's existing Equity Distribution Agreement.
: Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (SEPA) for up to $15.0 million of common shares
: Mutual decision; no activity outstanding under facility
